summary_1line: As battle begins, armies form Makara and Syena formations; Bhima, Arjuna, and others clash with Bhishma and Drona amid massive carnage.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima drives his chariot straight into the gaping mouth of the Makara formation and showers arrows at Bhishma standing at its center.
Sikhandin darkens the sky with arrows against Bhishma and Drona while Bhishma turns his chariot aside, refusing to fight him.
The battlefield becomes a red river of blood filled with fallen warriors, severed heads with golden earrings, and elephants raging under arrow storms.
